name: When should I engage a real estate agent for a luxury home purchase?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a real estate agent for a luxury home purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to engage a real estate agent specializing in luxury properties at the earliest stages of your search. An experienced agent, like Kelby Contreras, can provide critical market insights, access to off-market listings, and expert negotiation skills, which are particularly valuable in the competitive luxury market. Early engagement ensures you have a knowledgeable advocate from the moment you begin defining your criteria, saving time and potential complications in areas such as Aventura or West Palm Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a luxury real estate agent early for market insights, off-market access, and expert negotiation in a competitive market.
